description: Update the AI configuration. Send any subset of sections, each with any subset of its fields. Omitted fields keep their values. off_limits merges per category. Changing starters publishes to Instagram and Facebook at once, like the portal. Never touches the per-channel AI on/off switches. Changes how the live AI answers real customers. Call get_ai_config first, send only the fields that change, and confirm the change with the user. Saving starters publishes them to Instagram and Facebook at once. Booking hours (booking.hours, when customers can book): send only the days that change.

auto_escalation.description: Hand to a human on frustration or an explicit request.

batch_messages.description: Wait for rapid follow-up messages before answering.

copilot_enabled.description: The AI drafts, a person approves.

reply_pacing.description: How long after the lead's last message an AI reply arrives. instant: as soon as it is written. quick: about 15 to 30 seconds. natural: about 30 to 60. relaxed: about 60 to 90. Anything but instant turns batching on.

enabled.description: AI Booking. Off means the AI declines booking requests; the portal and the API can still book.

google_meet_invites.description: Send a Google Meet link and email invite for services marked virtual. Needs Google Calendar connected (409 not_connected otherwise) and forces email to required.

hours.description: When customers can book (AI and flow bookings), in the account timezone. Not opening hours: put those in an FAQ or the AI instructions. Only the days you send change, and only the fields you send on each. Any time is open 00:00, close 23:59 on every day. A day with closed false needs open and close.

required_fields.description: What the customer must provide to book. Send only the keys to change.

address_parts.description: Only meaningful when address is required.

dm_on_hide.description: DM the person when their comment is hidden.

enabled.description: Run the AI Comment Manager on comments no trigger claimed.

exclude_rules.description: Skip comments on these posts, or containing these words. Replaces the whole list.

instructions.description: Extra guidance for comment replies, on top of the knowledge base and the AI identity.

mode.description: auto posts replies at once; approval queues them under /comments.

moderation.description: Categories that get the comment hidden. True means hide. Send only the categories to change.

reply_length.description: short is 1 to 2 sentences, medium 2 to 3, detailed 3 to 5.

enabled.description: One switch for images, documents and videos. Enabling forces batching on.

default_customer_language.description: Customer language, used until a lead's own language is known: for the AI reply to a message with no real words (an emoji, "ok", a name) and for automated messages (flow prompts, booking times, CSAT survey, fallback replies). Null means Automatic: the AI follows the language of the instructions and automated messages use English.

instructions.description: The custom rules and guidelines. The system prompt the business writes.

welcome_message.description: Sent as written on the first message of every new conversation. Null for no greeting.

welcome_mode.description: combined: welcome and the AI answer in one message. standalone: welcome only, the AI answers the next message.

off_limits.description: Send only the categories to change.

mode.description: ice_breakers shows questions, get_started shows one button.

name: update_ai_config
